policy: Synthetic demonstration assumptions, not verified university regulations: attendance minimum 75%; minimum total pass mark 40/100; internal assessment maximum 40 and end-semester examination maximum 60. Grade points: A+=10 (90+), A=9 (85–89), B+=8 (80–84), B=7 (75–79), C+=6 (70–74), C=5 (65–69), D=4 (60–64), E=3 (40–59), F=0 (below 40 or failed attendance). SGPA is credit-weighted within a semester and CGPA is credit-weighted across completed semesters, using the final grade after any reattempt. Failed courses contribute zero grade points and no earned credits until cleared. A reattempt replaces the failed grade in the GPA calculation, while the original marks, attendance, and failure reason remain in the attempt history.
